tools.name: sprint_summary
tools.description: One sprint as the Sprint Summary view counts it: delivered items and points, cycle time, carryover, and commitment (committed at the end of day one, completed of committed, reliability, scope added and removed). Reads only numbers, dates, states and ids; never titles, descriptions, comments, tags or people, and never calls Baytek. Uses the customer’s saved workflow mapping only; no mapping answers {"error":"workflow-not-mapped"}. {"error":"licence-inactive"} means the organisation’s trial has ended without a valid licence, or its licence has not been confirmed for 30 days: tell the person to open Agile Analytics in Azure DevOps and, if the answer stays the same, to ask an admin to look at Configuration → License.

sprintId.description: Iteration GUID. Default: the last finished sprint (a running sprint is never summarised by default).

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Monte Carlo forecast from the throughput of the finished sprints among the last 12: how many items in a window, or when a backlog finishes. sampleSprints is how many sprints it drew from: say that number with the forecast. The hub’s Monte Carlo view and Dashboard start from the 6 newest finished sprints, so their figures can differ from this one.
